title: a page anyone can edit that contradicts a primary record
line: John Y Davidson's death certificate, as FamilySearch's index entry of it, gives the 11th first-hand and the rule keeps it; his Find a Grave memorial gives the 10th. The memorial is not trusted for a fact: its 10th is no veto, and the rule refuses the memorial only for want of a third of the four (his birth day and his father agree, his death and burial the file has only from the memorial itself); once the owner accepts the memorial as his, the certificate's day stands and the memorial's 10th, written undecided, is a contradiction the conflict names, which reconsider keeps (the owner, 3 Oct 2026: use the primary document and tag the page anyone can edit as a contradiction)
